index: S&P 500 price index; research input ^GSPC, not SPY or total return

assignment.target_definition: Official closing S&P 500 PRICE-index level from S&P Dow Jones Indices
assignment.status: Research only; explicitly choose final model and acquire November 12 data before freezing

factor_definitions.pcr5: sum Put(t-5..t-1)/sum Call(t-5..t-1), SPX+SPXW VOLUME all expiries; NOT a 6-day PCR window
factor_definitions.realized_vol20: sample std of 20 daily log returns ending t, ddof=1, times sqrt(252)

availability: t is the last completed regular-session close. Issue time is next US session at London noon, before regular New York open. PCR conservatively excludes t; price factors include t. Training target_date <= t. Original historical publication vintages remain unverified.
training_target: P_(t+6)/P_t-1; all coefficients are re-estimated for this horizon
evaluation: Common mature daily anchors; separately report Friday-London-noon to next-Friday-close cases. Weekly matching excludes holiday weeks where six actual sessions do not end next Friday.
uncertainty: Daily circular block bootstrap20 anchors,1500 replicates,seed20261027; weekly cases use blocks of4 observations; exploratory, no multiple-search correction
data: Frozen Yahoo ^GSPC daily closes and dated Cboe SPX+SPXW volumes; no new downloads for the horizon change
selection: Retain previous factors/windows. Horizon change is required by the assignment, not selected for historical error. Five-session outputs remain historical; six-session findings are exploratory.
